description: Generate a supplies and prep checklist grouped by area (food and drink, decorations, music and activities, practical, safety) for a home or venue party, with extra items for keywords like pool, bbq, costume, outdoor, kids, alcohol or potluck. Use when preparing what to buy and set up. Do NOT use for a dated plan (use party_timeline).

extras.description: Optional keywords that add themed items: pool, bbq, costume, outdoor, kids, alcohol, potluck, e.g. ["bbq","kids"]

venue.description: 'home' for a party at home, 'venue' for a hired venue or hall

name: party_checklist

items.description: Items to buy or do for this area

note.description: Summary of venue adjustments and extras applied

venue.description: Venue type the checklist was built for

title: Party checklist
